Which iteration are you referring to? I just compared the recent 153.7.0esr on Windows 11 with version 115.18.0 on Windows 7 and they both behave the same way:

- When there is a "Save for later" message in "Local Folders/Outbox", there is no warning message when Thunderbird is shut down.

- When there is a "Save for later" message in "Local Folders/Outbox", there IS the prompt, "Do you want to send your unsent messages now?" along with a checkbox asking whether you 'always want to be asked when you go online'.

- When there is a "Save for later" message in "Local Folders/Outbox" and I enable Work Offline, I get the prompt, and also when I disable Work Offline

- When I shut down while Thunderbird is still running (which I normally never do - I always shut down Thunderbird before shutting down the computer,) there is never any warning or prompt.

content:
Thaterror code usually means a timeout. The server must be busy. You could try lengthening the timeout setting to see if that helps.

  1. click to settings>general
  2. scroll to the bottom and, on the right, is 'config editor'. click that
  3. enter this: mailnews.tcptimeout
  4. I think you will see the default setting is 100. Change to 250 or higher save and exit
  5. restart thunderbird
